messages.content:
Author: Lenlyvit
Coauthors: Jutsa, The Ambis
Forum Thread: https://forum.nationstates.net/viewtopic.php?f=24&t=556853
Proposal Link: lol check the at-vote

Because people already voted there and it's funny, please continue casting your vote by reacting to this message: https://discord.com/channels/633351482128728064/633358400780238859/1388561548481532016

:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE
:tep_against:  = AGAINST / NAY
:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT

Personally, I'm against partly because I think it's a bit silly, partly because it reads like raider advertising from a defender, and partly because I used to hold a few trophy regions. I also find it telling that other defenders such as Quebec/Rhaza are against this
However, my strength was never the SC and I'd like to hear others' thoughts
ill be honest with you i got no opinion on this
but i think it's a good try at a relevant declaration at least
That it is
Not a very nuanced stance, but it's far better than the usual bad jokes (flashback to all the promises of declarations' potential to reshape the SC)
hehe
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE] SC - Ending the Practice of Trophy and Display Regions (Resolution at Vote)
[At vote] (res at vote)? lol
It's super duper extra at vote!
Nah, I'm against this
I usually mark ``(Resolution at Vote)`` as not to duplicate [AT VOTE] but to indicate the thread was created after the vote was live. Like as a delayed discussion/vote
Clever
sorry @Bishop Ambisius I
Usually we're ahead of the game but when there's no queue and one sneaks in or I just forget about one I make this designation :suiwheeze:
Any specific issues?
I hold a number of trophey regions that have been the subject of anti-fash movements mainly
p sure this gives an exemption to anti-fash movements iirc
no, there's only an "understanding" line
no exceptions
yeah that line gives the exemption at the end
Even so
Still agianst is as I like trophies. The raidas can't get badges anymore, but they still can control regions
The raiders won, and that is their trophy
I get the argument for it, but this is a game and games have winners and losers and typically trophies to go along with the winners
"Display regions" is defined in a kinda silly way
Every region by definition denies others the abilities to use its name
Wtf shadow
Trophy regions cool
Oh I know
TEP votes AGAINST. Resolution defeated. (3-6-0-0)
